title: Annual Number of Job Scam Victims Aged 60 and Above in Last Three Years
what_it_is: Annual Number of Job Scam Victims Aged 60 and Above in Last Three Years

sections.label: Job scam victims aged 60
sections.summary: Those aged 60 and above formed about 2% of job scam victims, while around 70% were aged 20 to 39.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) for the last three years, what is the annual number of victims of job scams who are aged 60 and above; and (b) what are the targeted measures to protect seniors who are looking for jobs from falling prey to these scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Those aged 60 older formed about 2% of the total number of victims.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The majority – around 70% – were younger adults aged between 20 and 39.

sections.label: Police outreach to seniors
sections.summary: Police work with AIC and SGO, and with MCI and IMDA through the SG Cyber Safe Seniors and Seniors Go Digital programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To reach out to seniors, the Police work with the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) and Silver Generation Office (SGO).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have also worked with MCI and IMDA through the SG Cyber Safe Seniors programme and the Seniors Go Digital programme in our outreach to our seniors.

sections.label: Anti-scam operations against job scams
sections.summary: SPF ran three operations from September to November 2021 and worked with Royal Malaysia Police in December 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Between September and November 2021, SPF conducted three island-wide anti-scam enforcement operations targeting money mules linked to job scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These led to the arrest of 135 individuals and investigation of 141 others.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In December 2021, SPF worked with the Royal Malaysia Police to dismantle two scam syndicates believed to have perpetrated job scams and fixed deposit investment scams targeting Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Fifteen people were arrested – eight in Malaysia and seven in Singapore.
